scoring_rubric: Baseline Probability is the model output from ARR-weighted historical close rates. Signal Adjust is additive and ranges -0.30..+0.30 based on three signals: usage change (±0.15), support sentiment (±0.10), exec alignment (±0.05). Adjusted Probability = clamp(baseline + signal, 0.05, 0.99). Priority buckets: Critical (>0.7 & ARR>250k), High (>0.6), Medium (0.35-0.6), Low (<0.35).
heatmap_guidance: Use priority + adjusted probability to color cells: red (Critical), orange (High), yellow (Medium), green (Low). For sprints, focus top 6 rows by (ARR * Adjusted Probability) descending. Track 3 explicit next steps per sprint: Outreach, Executive alignment, Legal/Contract action.
next_step_templates: Outreach: "Hi <champ>, can we book a 30m QBR to review usage and renewal options? Proposed times: <two options>. Agenda: usage, ROI, product roadmap, contract options.
Exec Align: "Request 15m with SVP/VP to confirm business priorities and get renewal decision path. Share one-pager on value and ROI.
Legal/Finance: "Share draft SOW and proposed term sheet. Ask for list of required compliance attachments and timeline for review.
